run_benchmark_cli: run the torchserve AB benchmark suite with custom concurrency, requests, and model URL via click CLI
run_benchmark_docker: run the torchserve benchmark in a docker container with specified GPU count and custom image
run_benchmark_profiling: run the torchserve benchmark with backend CProfile and handler profiling enabled
review_benchmark_function: review the benchmark click command that orchestrates torchserve start, model registration, warm up, and report generation
refactor_getAPIS: refactor the getAPIS function to parse config.properties and extract management and inference API URLs
